title: Schedule C

origin.title: TY2025 Form 1040 MeF Assurance Testing System (ATS) Test Scenario 12, Schedule C (pages 8-9)
origin.clearance_note: Published by the IRS for e-file software developers as part of the Tax Year 2025 Form 1040 series MeF Assurance Testing System, and linked from irs.gov/e-file-providers/tax-year-2025-form-1040-series-and-extensions-modernized-e-file-mef-assurance-testing-system-ats-information. A US government work, in the public domain. Downloaded by script. The source is a 15-page scenario packet (cover sheet, Form 1040, Schedules 1, 2, C and SE, Forms 7206 and 7217, and a W-2); pages 8-9, the completed Schedule C (2025), were split out with PyMuPDF and no content was altered. Every value is IRS test data for a fictitious sole proprietor: the SSN is in the 400-00 range the ATS reserves for test scenarios and the address is in Anytown. No redaction needed. PDF metadata was reset to the IRS as author and a title naming the scenario. The IRS may replace this file in place, so the committed copy is the record.

notes: The request had no feature_page or fields keys; its notes suggested business name, line 1 gross receipts, line 7 gross income, line 28 total expenses and line 31 net profit, preferring Part I and the summary lines over the two-column Part II grid. All five ground ok on page 1 and shipped as suggested. The story runs down the page from the business to its bottom line: ENERGY BUILD takes in 35,235, spends 10,907 and nets 24,328. 35,235 is printed on lines 1, 3, 5 and 7, and lines 1 and 7 each ground to their own amount cell. No person is featured. Page 2 (Parts III to V) is blank on the form and is kept so the folder holds the complete schedule. Known extraction faults, left visible: blank amount lines extract as 0 rather than null; line 32 (at risk) extracts as all_at_risk and line J (filed required 1099s) as false, although both boxes on each line are unchecked and the parse reads them as [ ]. One extraction-only rerun with descriptions asking for null on unchecked boxes and empty cells changed nothing. None of these is featured.
